<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/license"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Deletes license.json from disk, logs the removal, attempts to reload
the runtime so it picks up the now-absent license (a failed reload is
logged but not raised), and emits a license-removed audit event before
returning a removal confirmation.
